verdict.rationale: Rootly has its own AI agents (AI SRE, Rootly AI) that could plausibly act as MCP clients, so this story applies. However, the evidence never shows users registering external MCP servers for Rootly AI to call. The documented Rootly MCP Server works the other way, exposing Rootly's tools to outside clients. The first-party connectors (Atlassian, AWS, observability) are a related but different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
